target_customer: Early adopter consumers willing to pre-order an AI-first phone
problem: Phones require opening apps and tapping through screens; users want to tell the phone what they want and have an AI agent do it.
business_model: Consumer hardware sales with refundable deposits, a $199 deposit toward an estimated $699 price
product_category: AI-first smartphone operating system and hardware

founders.name: Adam Zinebi
previous_startups: B2B music generation startup selling models to artists in Morocco and Switzerland
founders.background_notes: Per YC page; won YC Call-My-Agent Hackathon. The listed affiliations are as shown on YC and not distinguished as employers or schools.

founders.name: Thomas Kiefer
founders.background_notes: Per YC page; degrees not stated.

competitors.name: StepFun StepX Neo
competitors.what: Agentic AI phone not built as Android with AI on top

competitors.name: OpenAI AI phone
competitors.what: Reported agent-centered smartphone with Qualcomm and MediaTek

competitors.name: Rabbit R1
competitors.traction_then: Criticized for limited app integrations at launch

technical_complexity.rationale: Agents controlling arbitrary apps at OS level reliably, plus plans for custom hardware and FCC authorization, with a team of two.

defensibility.rationale: Runs on stock Pixel hardware; Google, Apple and OpenAI are building agent phones, and some banking apps may block automation.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Large players were pursuing agent phones by 2026; no action against Cyclon found as of 2026-11.

market_need_then: Coverage in 2026 shows interest in agent-driven phones, with the demo drawing about 1.4 million views on X, but skeptics question whether users want AI handling every interaction.

identity.logo: Not described by any source found
identity.visual_style: Minimal scroll-driven site with bracketed section labels
identity.voice_and_tone: Mission-led; tagline The AI phone that adapts to you, give people back their time

branding.brand_signature: Demo video and replace your iPhone claim
branding.community_and_virality: Launch demo reached about 1.4 million views on X per one report; covered by 9to5Google, Gadget Flow and Mac4Ever in November 2026.

brand_strength.rationale: Launch week press from several outlets and a viral demo, but the brand is days old.

outcome_analysis: Cyclon launched its AI phone OS on 2026-11-03 on a Pixel 8a prototype, with a viral demo and press. No funding is disclosed. Hardware, FCC authorization and reliability are open risks, and large platform owners are building similar products.
notes: No funding amount found; deposits are pre-orders, not rounds. One outlet claimed $999 and September 2027, which conflicts with the company site ($699, Q2 2027) and is treated as unreliable. No shutdown or acquisition found.
